main_text.l: Econtrà, quum omnium optimum non bis fit, si Deus fit omnia in omnibus. 1. Cor. 15.28. quum etiam in coelis degentes sint extra telorum peccati & mortis iactum, tutissime in ijs agitur: denique quum nulla sit satietas rerum spiritualium, iucundissi-ma[?] ea demum vita censeri debet, quae perpetuo plenoque eorundem vsu constat.
Porrò, etiam pius dum in his terris militat, partim Deo seruit, partim ea quae huius mundi sunt curat 1.Cor.7.33.
Quare nihil mihi magis optandum est, quàm vt ad Deum ipsum, qui me gratiæ suæ praesentia hactenus tam paternè dignatus est, totus migrem, ac mundo huic plane valedicam.

Caeterùm secundum Deum, hoc idem omnes sancti, tantisper dum militant in his terris, piè expetunt. Etenim proficere eos decet, & quum ideò gratiæ suæ praesentia, Deum sese dignari intelligant, vt aliquando in coelum translati claro confpectu Dei fruantur, hunc expetere, & ad eum summo eniti & contendere studio debent.

page.notes: The reference "1. Cor. 15.28." stands inline in the text line after "omnibus.", not in a margin, so it is kept in the paragraph. "iucundissi-ma" is doubtful: the line-end mark reads like a hyphen with an ornament, and the reading is marked [?]. The reference "1.Cor.7.33." is partly smudged and is only a best reading. The running head numeral "LXXXIII" is faint and is uncertain. The word "tantisper" is spelled as printed. No printing errors were corrected.
